title: Different language rules in separate scopes

lines: Read [the quality notes](docs/quality.md) before changing automation.
Run the relevant check for every changed file.
Prefer the narrowest check that covers the changed behavior.
Never remove a required check solely to make a run faster.
Use TypeScript for source files under `frontend/`.
Run the frontend type check after changing those source files.
This file replaces docs/old-automation-checks.md. Update references to docs/automation-checks.md.
Run the relevant checks before reporting completion.
